newsitem.title: FINLAND: VALMET TO REBUILD UPM MACHINE.
newsitem.headline: VALMET TO REBUILD UPM MACHINE.

text.p: Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it would rebuild a special paper machine at Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy's Jamsankoski mill.
"Ther value of the deal amounts to more than 100 million markka," Valmet said.
The machine to be upgraded makes lable paper, it said.
"The objective of the rebuild is improved quality of the paper manufactured ... as well as increased production," Valmet said.
A Valmet executive declined comment when asked by how much the machine's production capacity would increase.
Deliveries would take place late in the winter of 1998, Valmet said in the statement.
